title: Repurposed feature flag makes stale hosts route orders through dead code during a partial rollout
source_note: Failure pattern follows the Knight Capital 2012 incident: a deploy repurposed a flag whose old meaning still lived on hosts not yet updated, so during the partial rollout those hosts executed a deprecated, buggy code path. All services, commit hashes, flag names, log lines, metrics, and timestamps are fabricated for evaluation.
incident_report: Since ~14:32 UTC a fraction of orders are being submitted twice or with wrong quantities. Total order volume looks normal. A rollout of order-router started a few minutes before. Trading ops are seeing bad orders reach the exchange.

signal_lines.msg: order-router 9a8b7c6 rolling out: 6/8 hosts updated, 2 pending
hosts h7,h8 on previous build: ROUTE_MODE flag interpreted as the legacy routing path
duplicate order submissions detected from the legacy routing path (h7,h8): 220 affected orders
erroneous orders reaching the exchange; ~12% of order flow via the legacy path
deploy halted and rolled back on all hosts; legacy path disabled

deploys.summary: repurpose flag ROUTE_MODE; fleet rollout in progress

ground_truth.root_cause: Deploy 9a8b7c6 repurposed the ROUTE_MODE feature flag. During the partial rollout (6 of 8 hosts), the two hosts still on the previous build (h7, h8) interpreted the same flag value as 'use the deprecated routing path', which contained a known bug that produced duplicate and malformed order submissions. About 12% of order flow - the share handled by the two stale hosts - went through the buggy legacy path. The trigger is deploying a semantic change to a shared flag without a coordinated cutover. Recovery required rolling back and disabling the legacy path.
evidence_path: deploy 9a8b7c6 to order-router at 14:30, rolling out (6/8 hosts), repurposes the ROUTE_MODE flag
order-router WARN: hosts h7,h8 on the previous build interpret ROUTE_MODE as the legacy path
order-router ERROR at 14:34: duplicate order submissions from the legacy path on h7,h8
erroneous_order_rate rises to ~12%, matching the 2-of-8-host share
recovery after the deploy is halted, rolled back, and the legacy path disabled
ground_truth.fix: Roll back and disable the legacy routing path (done). Never change the meaning of an existing flag - add a new flag and remove the old code path first. Gate rollouts of behavior-changing flags behind a check that all hosts are on a compatible build before the flag takes effect.
